name: J-Oil Mills Inc
summary: J-Oil Mills, Inc., founded in Tokyo, Japan, in 1826, is a key producer and distributor of edible oils throughout Japan. Its diverse product portfolio caters to both household consumers and professional sectors. Retail offerings encompass AJINOMOTO brand olive oil, nutritional oils marketed as AJINOMOTO Kenko Plus, health food items such as AJINOMOTO Kenko Sarara, and various flavored and seasoning oils, including those specifically for fried rice and Sichuan pepper. For industrial applications, the company provides specialized products like grilling oil under the J-OILPRO Seasoning Oils brand. Beyond its core oil business, J-Oil Mills manufactures oilseed meals and a range of processed fats, including margarine and shortening sold under the Rama, Meister, and Gran Master labels, as well as powdered oil and fat products. The company also supplies foodstuffs and specialized ingredients, such as starches and MAMENORI-SAN brand soybean sheets, alongside chemicals like resin, paint, and wood adhesives. Further diversifying its operations, J-Oil Mills is involved in the production, processing, and sale of feedstuffs and fertilizers. Additionally, it distributes food production equipment, manages real estate leasing activities, and offers warehousing services.
